server_header.Rd

Create a default header block

Usage

server_header(title, ..., program, date_range, region, county)

Arguments

title

(character) Title to be wrapped in h2

program

(character) Program name to be wrapped in h4

date_range

(Date) vector to be collapsed with `" - "` in h4

Value

shiny.tag.list
